title: 第9章 万人空巷的比试第10章 临场突破震惊全场
lines: 三日后，青云坊市中心广场。
天色未亮，广场四周已是人山人海。
低阶修士、凡人摊贩、好奇的过客……至少数千人围聚在此，嘈杂声音如同蜂群嗡鸣。
广场中央临时搭起了一座丈许高的木台，台子用红布装饰，正中摆放两张长桌。
左侧长桌后坐着陈大师，他今日换了一身崭新的三品丹师袍，胸前火焰纹熠熠生辉，身后站着两名捧药箱的学徒，气派十足。
右侧长桌后，林澈安静地坐着。
他依旧是一身布衣，面前摆着那个装着导灵银器械的木盒，以及几包草药。
赵虎和周老站在他身后，神色肃穆。
台下前排，坐着五位评判：坊市城主府的管事、护卫队副队长、以及三位在散修中德高望重的老修士。
血狼佣兵团二十余人站在林澈一侧的台下，抱臂而立，煞气腾腾，让许多想往前挤的人望而却步。
辰时三刻，一阵锣响。
城主府的管事起身，朗声道：“今日，炼丹师公会陈大师，与妙手堂林大夫，公开比试医术。
患者为‘玄阴绝脉’之症，双方各施手段，以治疗效果为准。
由我等五人共同评判，确保公平。”
他顿了顿，看向双方：“二位，可还有异议？”
陈大师抚须微笑：“无异议。”
林澈面色平静地说：“无。”
管事一挥手，“请患者上台。”
两个护卫搀扶着裹在厚棉衣里的小莲，缓缓走上木台。
女孩脸色苍白如纸，即使在初夏的早晨，依然冷得浑身发抖，呼出的气息凝成白雾。
台下响起一片低低的惊呼。
“真是玄阴绝脉！
你看她呼出的气都结霜了！”
“这病没治的，陈大师怎么选这个？”
“就是，治不好也不算丢人，反正大家都治不好。”
陈大师起身，走到小莲面前，装模作样地把了把脉，又看了看舌苔，摇头叹息：“阴寒入骨，丹田冰封，果然是典型的玄阴绝脉。
此症凶险，老夫也只能尽力而为。”
他回到桌前，从药箱中取出一只玉盒。
打开盒盖，一股灼热的气息弥漫开来，距离近的人甚至感到皮肤发烫。
盒中是一枚龙眼大小、通体赤红的丹药，表面有三道淡金色的丹纹流转。
“三品顶级——九阳融脉丹！”
有识货的修士惊呼。
“这丹药据说要用九九八十一种阳属性灵材，炼制七七四十九天才能成丹！
一枚就值上百灵石！”
“陈大师真是下了血本啊！”
陈大师面露得色，将丹药递给小莲：“孩子，服下此丹，老夫以灵力助你化开药力，或有一线生机。”
小莲的母亲在台下紧张地看着，双手合十祈祷。
小莲颤抖着接过丹药，吞下。
丹药入腹的瞬间，她苍白的脸上涌起不同寻常的潮红，身体剧烈颤抖起来。
陈大师立刻双掌抵住她的后背，浑厚的火属性灵力源源不断注入，催发药力。
content_en:
Three days later, Qingyunfang downtown square.
It was still dark, but the square was already crowded with people.
Low-level monks, mortal vendors, curious passers-by... at least thousands of people gathered here, and the noise was like the buzzing of a swarm of bees.
A wooden platform about ten feet high was temporarily erected in the center of the square. The platform was decorated with red cloth and two long tables were placed in the middle.
Master Chen is sitting behind the long table on the left. He has changed into a brand-new third-grade alchemist robe today, with flame patterns shining brightly on his chest. Behind him are two apprentices holding medicine boxes, full of majesty.
Behind the long table on the right, Lin Che sat quietly.
He was still dressed in cloth, and in front of him lay the wooden box containing the silver spiritual instrument and several packages of herbal medicine.
Zhao Hu and Mr. Zhou stood behind him with solemn expressions.
In the front row of the audience, there were five judges sitting: the steward of Fang City City Lord's Mansion, the deputy captain of the escort team, and three highly respected old monks among casual cultivators.
More than 20 people from the Blood Wolf Mercenary Group stood at Lin Che's side of the stage, standing with their arms folded, and their fierce aura discouraged many people who wanted to push forward.
At three o'clock in the morning, a gong sounded.
The steward of the City Lord's Mansion stood up and said loudly: "Today, Master Chen of the Alchemist Guild and Dr. Lin of Miaoshou Hall will have a public competition in their medical skills.
The patient suffers from the disease of 'Xuan Yin's broken pulse', and both parties use their own methods to determine the therapeutic effect.
It will be judged by five people including me to ensure fairness. "
He paused and looked at both sides: "You two, do you still have any objections?"
Master Chen stroked his beard and smiled: "No objection."
Lin Che said calmly: "Nothing."
"Okay."
The steward waved his hand and said, "Invite the patient to come to the stage."
Two guards supported Xiaolian, who was wrapped in thick cotton clothes, and slowly walked onto the wooden platform.
The girl's face was as pale as paper. Even in the early summer morning, she was still shivering from the cold, and her breath condensed into white mist.
There was a low exclamation in the audience.
“It’s really Xuanyin Juemai!
Look, her breath is frosted! "
"There is no cure for this disease, so why would Master Chen choose this one?"
"That's right, it's not a shame if it can't be cured. Everyone can't cure it anyway."
Master Chen stood up, walked to Xiaolian, pretended to take her pulse, looked at the tongue coating, shook his head and sighed: "The yin is cold to the bones, and the Dantian is frozen. It is indeed a typical Xuanyin Jumai.
This disease is dangerous, so I can only do my best. "
He returned to the table and took out a jade box from the medicine box.
When the lid of the box is opened, a hot breath fills the air, and those who are close to it may even feel their skin burning.
In the box is a longan-sized, red elixir with three pale golden elixir patterns flowing on its surface.
"Third grade top grade - Jiuyang Melting Pulse Pill!"
The knowledgeable monk exclaimed.
"It is said that this elixir requires ninety-nine and eighty-one kinds of Yang-attribute spiritual materials, and it takes seven, seventy-nine and forty-nine days to refine it into a pill!
One piece is worth hundreds of spirit stones! "
"Master Chen really spent a lot of money!"
Master Chen looked pleased and handed the elixir to Xiaolian: "My child, take this elixir and I will use my spiritual power to help you dissolve the elixir, and you may have a chance of survival."
Xiaolian's mother watched nervously from the audience, clasping her hands in prayer.
Xiaolian took the elixir tremblingly and swallowed it.
The moment the elixir entered her stomach, an unusual flush appeared on her pale face, and her body began to tremble violently.
Master Chen immediately put his palms against her back, and poured in a steady stream of strong fire-attribute spiritual power to activate the medicine.
title_en: Chapter 9: A competition with thousands of people in the crowd Chapter 10: A breakthrough on the spot shocked the whole audience
